description: Corrugated walls sweating avgas and cold metal, a half-stripped flyer up on jacks, and cargo nobody's labelling stacked under tarps along the back wall. A flight-ops desk faces the apron door, its radio hissing quiet static. Whatever came in on the last plane is still here, and nobody's asking whose it is.

flags.intro_lore: Welcome to the Reach — a smear of light in a hundred miles of scrub, cut off from every road the Architect ever paved. You come in by air or you don't come in, and Buzzard Field is the only door. They'll take your fuel money and your silence and, if you're the right kind of wrong, they'll let you stay. The Reach doesn't trust outsiders; it survives on the ones it lets in. Whatever you're running from out there hasn't got wings — and whatever you're running, nobody here will ask to see it.

name: The Hangar Bay
